notes.title: Open Beta - Participate in the August Play Test!
notes.content:
Sign up now to join the play testers for Existence: The Outer Reach. We are accepting the first 100 participates to try the game on August 1st. You will have access to the game for 7 days to try it out and provide your feedback. You will also be included in all future play tests as well. You can sign up by visiting the store page and selecting Request Access to be a play tester.

Multiplayer offers a PvP and Co-Op mode, but we have not set up lobbies yet, so you will need to invite your friends in order to have someone to play against. Or join our Discord server to find a game. Be prepared for intense action as you will likely be required to command multiple fronts on different planets simultaneously. We'd love to hear what strategies work best for you!
